caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

How Computer Chips are Printed with 50,000 Laser Blasts 🔬

💡 ASML machines vaporize 50,000 molten tin droplets per second with high-power CO2 lasers, generating extreme ultraviolet light to etch billions of nanometer transistors.
